title: (tests) slot-claim dispatch authz + replay tests
description: Tests bead for children worker6-2hte (dispatch gate) and worker6-gskf (replay). There is NO existing slot_coord host test dir (lichen/tests has no coap_slot_coord*), so create lichen/tests/coap_slot_coord_authz following lichen/tests/coap_config layout, reusing the Schnorr48 fixtures from test/vectors/schnorr48.json for signed claims. ACCEPTANCE: (1) unprotected non-admin claim POST -> 4.01 and gateway table unchanged; (2) protected valid signed claim -> grant encoded, state mutated as today; (3) protected INVALID signature -> silently discarded (no response body change, no grant), GCP-6.3; (4) unprotected-from-admin path still processed; (5) replay: same valid signed claim delivered twice -> second occurrence does not re-mutate allocation (oracle: expected grant sequence per test/vectors + Rust SlotClaimVerifier semantics, NOT the C code under test); (6) concurrent-claim conflict still resolves lowest-IID-wins. Run via the standard host CMake test recipe (cmake && ctest --output-on-failure).
